nodes.note: sodoto-onboard.html — the page a new person opens to create their identity. It makes an Ed25519 signing key in their browser, locks a recovery copy with their passphrase, and shows their public name (DID). Nothing is sent anywhere.
nodes.label:
sodoto-onboard.html
mint identity

nodes.note: sodoto-sign.html — where a person signs an attestation for one gate (See / Do / Teach). It loads their key and produces a signed token proving THEY attested; if the key isn't on this device, they restore it from their recovery file + passphrase.
nodes.label:
sodoto-sign.html
sign gates

nodes.note: sodoto-issuer.html — the coordinator's tool. It registers people, records each gate, collects everyone's signed attestations, then seals the finished credential with the NDC key and writes the badge to the portfolio.
nodes.label:
sodoto-issuer.html
coordinator

nodes.note: sodoto-crypto.js — shared code that locks and unlocks the private key with a passphrase (encrypt on onboarding, decrypt on restore). It's how you recover your identity on another device.
nodes.label:
sodoto-crypto.js
passphrase recovery

nodes.note: The person's self-custodied identity — a did:key (a public name built from an Ed25519 key pair). The private half lives only on their device; the public half is safe to share and is what verifies their signatures.
nodes.label:
Learner did:key
(self-custodied)

nodes.note: Attestation JWTs — the signed statements each party makes at a gate: the learner ('I did it'), the mentor ('I witnessed it'), and at Teach One the student ('I was taught'). Each is a signature no one else can forge.
nodes.label:
Attestation JWTs
learner·mentor·student

nodes.note: people-registry — the list of who's enrolled: name, public DID, and portfolio page. The coordinator reads and updates it; sofi-proxy serves it.
nodes.label: people-registry

nodes.note: sofi-proxy — the small server that hands out the browser tools and writes finished badges into the wiki on the browser's behalf (a web page can't write wiki files directly). It also runs the demo seed.
nodes.label:
sofi-proxy
tools + wiki write API + seed

nodes.note: The Credential / Badge — a single signed token (JWT) that IS the credential. It records the skill, the gates, the embedded attestations, and the NDC's seal. It's the source of truth: verify it and you know it's real, with no server.
nodes.label:
Credential / Badge
(signed JWT) — source of truth

nodes.note: The NDC signing key — the cooperative's private Ed25519 key. Signing a credential with it is the institution's seal: 'this NDC vouches the gates were completed.'
nodes.label: NDC signing key

nodes.note: auto-seal engine (planned) — a server that verifies the full set of signed attestations plus the mentor's qualification, then applies the NDC seal automatically — removing the human coordinator.
nodes.label: auto-seal engine

nodes.note: Caddy — the front-door web server that provides HTTPS (the padlock) and routes each web address to the right container. Not SODOTO-specific; just secure traffic.
nodes.label: Caddy — HTTPS

nodes.note: FedWiki — the wiki that hosts the portfolio pages and badges and renders each badge so anyone can view and verify it.
nodes.label:
FedWiki
portfolios + badges

nodes.note: sodoto-badge plugin — the code inside FedWiki that draws a badge and verifies its signatures (the NDC seal and each attestation) right in the browser, with no server call.
nodes.label:
sodoto-badge plugin
verify + render

nodes.note: wiki-security-did (planned) — a FedWiki add-on that lets a person edit their own portfolio by proving control of their DID (a signed challenge), instead of a shared password.
nodes.label:
wiki-security-did
(ownership)

nodes.note: GHCR (GitHub Container Registry) — the public shelf where the built container images are stored. Marc pushes images here; the server pulls them from here to run.
nodes.label: GHCR

nodes.note: rcn-sodoto-proxy image — the packaged container that runs sofi-proxy and contains the browser tools and the demo seed.
nodes.label: rcn-sodoto-proxy image

nodes.note: rcn-sodoto-wiki image — the packaged container that runs FedWiki with the badge plugin baked in.
nodes.label: rcn-sodoto-wiki image

nodes.note: Ed25519 / did:key (WebCrypto) — the cryptography everything rests on. Ed25519 is the signature scheme; a did:key is a public identity built from an Ed25519 key; WebCrypto is the browser engine that signs and verifies. Verifying a badge needs only this and the badge.
nodes.label:
did:key / Ed25519
(WebCrypto)

nodes.note: WikiCafe — the server (run by Christian) that pulls the images from GHCR and runs the live SODOTO system over HTTPS.
nodes.label:
WikiCafe
(pulls images)

nodes.note: Neo4j teaching-graph projector (a lens) — reads the badges and builds a queryable graph of who taught whom. It's a view over the badges, never something the system depends on.
nodes.label:
Neo4j teaching-graph
projector (lens)
